messages:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up: we're seeing some legacy mobile clients (v1.2) still send 'Authorization: Token <key>' rather than 'x-api-key'. Is that still supported or should we start rejecting? Also what's our rotation window for keys that only exist in the old format? Need to decide for the upcoming rollout.
Mira Patel: We're still accepting the 'Authorization' header for backward compat but with deprecation warning in logs. Plan was to revoke after 30d from announce. Is that date still ok?
Jonah Kim: Quick check — current middleware order is: 1) x-api-key 2) Authorization Bearer 3) Authorization Token fallback. So Token is last and subject to stricter rate limits. I can paste the snippet.
Jonah Kim: ```python
# auth middleware order
if 'x-api-key' in headers:
  use_key(headers['x-api-key'])
elif headers.get('Authorization', '').startswith('Bearer'):
  use_bearer(headers['Authorization'].split()[1])
elif headers.get('Authorization', '').startswith('Token'):
  use_legacy_token(headers['Authorization'].split()[1])
else:
  reject(401)
```
Sam O'Neill: That matches my testing. One gotcha: legacy tokens don't have org/project bindings; they implicitly map to the owner's default org. We should surface 403 vs 401 clearly.
Alex Rivera: For rotation, ops asked to enforce token revocation 2 weeks after PR merge that flips default. Can we make that canaryed in a week to reduce blast radius?
infra-bot: deploy sso-auth-mw v1.14 starting canary at 3 pods in us-west-2 :rocket:
Mira Patel: +1 for canary. Jonah can you add a feature-flag gated config to toggle rejecting 'Token' header entirely? Then we can flip for customers.
Jonah Kim: Yep - I'll add `legacy_token_reject` flag in config (false by default). I'll also add a metric `auth.legacy_token.count` and a warning log that includes client version when available.
devex-lead: Heads-up for SDKs: we'll add telemetry to show when clients still send Authorization: Token and send an upgrade prompt in the next SDK release.
Sam O'Neill: Also need an API contract update: response error shape when missing project/org header. Right now we return 401 with body `{error:'unauthenticated'}`; for missing project we should return 403 + `{'error':'project_missing','hint':'add X-Project-Id or upgrade key'}`.
Mira Patel: Agree. Make sure docs and OpenAPI reflect that. Alex can you open a tiny PR to docs and the middleware change? Ping me when ready and I'll schedule the canary.
Alex Rivera: On it. Filing PR now and adding test cases for: 1) Authorization Token accepted (legacy) 2) Token rejected behind flag 3) Missing X-Project-Id returns 403 with new shape.
Jonah Kim: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4032 (WIP) — tests included.
Mira Patel: Thanks — adding to tomorrow's eng-platform async check-in. :thumbsup:
Alex Rivera: thanks all. We'll monitor `auth.legacy_token.count` and rotate once counts drop 95%.
